RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

The panel's composition isn't evidence of anything here. The person hired was also a woman, so a sex-based preference would have had to run in your favour as much as hers. All-women panels occur routinely in planning and HR-heavy fields and carry no inference on their own.

Raising it would likely damage your credibility and your standing with that municipality — and it distracts from a real question: why did lesser formal credentials win? Plausible answers include political skill, stakeholder management, internal candidacy, or a council wanting a consultation-focused shift.

Do follow up on your written explanation request. Put it in writing, cite any applicable records or access-to-information rules, and ask for the scoring matrix.
